business_summary: Arakawa Chemical Industries, Ltd. provides chemicals for functional coating agents and paper manufacturing, resins for printing inks and adhesives, and materials for electronics in Japan, China, Asia, North and South America, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Functional Coating Chemicals, Paper Chemicals & Environmental Business, Adhesive & Biomass Materials, Fine Chemicals & Electronics, and Other segments. It offers functional coating chemicals comprising photo-curable, thermosetting, rosin modified phenolic, polyurethane, maleic, alkyd, polyester, modified epoxy, and styrene maleic resins, as well as resins for printing ink and paint, and functional coating agents; and paper chemicals and environmental products consisting of internal and wet paper strengthening agents, sizing agents, new water-based polymers, internal and surface size, sprayable paper strengthening agents, paper surface improving agents, and water repellant agents. It also provides adhesive and biomass materials, such as hydrogenated hydrocarbon resins, tackifiers for adhesive and pressure sensitive adhesive, colorless rosin derivatives, emulsifiers for synthetic rubber polymerization, rosin esters, terpene and alkyl phenolic resins, disproportionate and polymerized rosins, and hydrogenated rosins; and fine chemicals and electronic products, including precise parts cleaning agents, cleaning systems and its peripheral equipment, low-dielectric polyimide resins, compounds for electronic materials, precision polishing agents, solders for use in electronics, thermoplastic polyimide solutions, organic-inorganic hybrid resins, and hybrid polyimide films. In addition, the company offers non-life insurance and real estate management activities.  The company was formerly known as Arakawa Forest Chemical Industries, Ltd. and changed its name to Arakawa Chemical Industries, Ltd. in April 1977. The company was founded in 1876 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Arakawa Chemical Industries, Ltd.는 일본, 중국, 아시아, 북미 및 남미, 유럽 및 국제적으로 기능성 코팅제 및 제지 제조용 화학 물질, 인쇄 잉크 및 접착제용 수지, 전자 재료를 제공합니다. 기능성 코팅 화학, 종이 화학 및 환경 사업, 접착제 및 바이오매스 재료, 정밀 화학 및 전자 및 기타 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 광경화성, 열경화성, 로진 변성 페놀, 폴리우레탄, 말레산, 알키드, 폴리에스터, 변성 에폭시, 스티렌 말레산 수지를 포함하는 기능성 코팅 약품과 인쇄 잉크 및 페인트용 수지, 기능성 코팅제를 제공합니다. 내부 및 젖은 종이 강화제, 사이징제, 새로운 수성 폴리머, 내부 및 표면 크기, 분무 가능한 종이 강화제, 종이 표면 개선제 및 발수제로 구성된 종이 화학 물질 및 환경 제품. 또한 수소화 탄화수소 수지, 접착제 및 감압 접착제용 점착부여제, 무색 로진 유도체, 합성 고무 중합용 유화제, 로진 에스테르와 같은 접착제 및 바이오매스 재료를 제공합니다.
